README.md:
# PHARM D WITH HYZEN

Flutter Android app, com.hyzen.pharmd, source version 1.4.1+9.
Use Flutter 3.35.4 / Dart 3.9.2 and JDK 17.

PDF Studio includes Create PDF / native document scanning, on-device Latin OCR,
lossless page operations, editable PDF annotations, AES password and compression
exports, and a structured PDF/DOCX writer. Read docs/PDF_STUDIO_1_4_1.md for
scope and physical-device requirements. Drive cloud setup remains pending;
original online preview and public offline downloads now work as fallback routes.

This update replaces the fixed bottom navbar with an accessible floating Sections
drawer, improves compact layouts, removes duplicate downloads artwork, simplifies
login errors, fixes mobile-number error recovery and confirms profile saves.
Profile includes a swipeable promotion carousel driven by the existing catalog.
PDF reader supports text search, previous/next match, page controls and zoom.
The Studio top bar has Edit, bookmark and overflow tools.

Read **docs/DRIVE_PIPELINE_1_4.md** before testing live Drive files. The native
Drive API/PDFium pipeline needs owner Google Cloud API/OAuth setup. The existing
Firebase key is restricted from DriveFiles.Get and no Android OAuth client is
configured in the original Google services file. Missing/disabled API setup
automatically selects the original Google online preview. Public downloads use
Google's download/export endpoints, including bounded large-file confirmation;
Google still enforces file permissions and download restrictions. Native API
reading remains the preferred configured route, with an Online preview action
if the reader fails. This app contains no service
account credentials or OAuth client secrets. The Google connection is optional
for local files and separate from email/password app login.

Native offline transfers stream to app storage, show progress, retain paused
partials and resume when validators and HTTP Range permit. A PDF is finalized
only after type/end-marker/length checks. Deletion only affects local copies.

The project retains all existing backend URLs and existing owner signing
identity. Release signing secrets are excluded from this archive and restored
only in the owner's private GitHub build. Do not replace the key.

Build:
    flutter pub get
    dart format lib test
    dart fix --apply
    flutter analyze --no-pub
    flutter test --no-pub
    flutter build apk --release

Actual live Google speed comparison, signed-in backend acceptance and physical
phone gesture testing require the owner's configured accounts/devices.
PDF Studio page manipulation preserves text/vectors; flattening is explicit.
See docs/PDF_STUDIO_1_4_1.md for implemented tools and remaining format limits.

docs/PDF_STUDIO_1_4_1.md:
# PDF Studio 1.4.1+9

Create PDF is available in PDF Studio. Scan with camera launches Google's native
document scanner, with gallery import, edge crop, rotate, cleanup and multi-page
review. Up to 50 pages may be saved as one PDF into the existing private workspace.
Cancellation saves nothing. Scanner availability depends on Google Play services
and at least 1.7 GB device RAM; first use may download the scanner. Gallery image
conversion remains available as a fallback. Scans stay on-device.

Page merge, split and organization now use Apache-licensed PdfBox Android page
imports, retaining text and vectors. Flattened export remains an explicit image
copy. Editable export adds standard PDF annotations separately from page content.
Native PDF readers vary in which annotations they allow users to modify.
This does not edit pre-existing PDF paragraph text or constitute a certificate
based digital signature. Typed signatures are visual annotations.

The new structured document writer creates PDF or DOCX with paragraph-level bold,
italic, underline, headings, lists, alignment, tables and images. It creates new
documents; arbitrary imported Word layouts are not round-trip edited. PDF-to-DOCX
remains text extraction rather than exact layout reconstruction.

OCR uses bundled on-device ML Kit Latin recognition (up to 50 pages). It can
export recognized text or create a searchable PDF with an invisible text layer.
Urdu/Arabic OCR is not included. Recognition quality depends on scan quality.

AES-128 password-protected copies require a 6–128 character password. Passwords
are never stored in history or configuration; originals remain unchanged.
Compression downsamples large embedded images with three quality presets and
retains text/vectors. A copy which would grow is discarded in favor of the original.
Images over 16 megapixels are skipped to bound memory use. Results depend on input.
JPEG-2000 images are preserved without recompression; the optional retired
PDFBox JP2Android codec is not bundled. Normal PDF viewing uses PDFium/Android.

Exports can go to Studio, Android Save As, or the native share sheet. Page-image
ZIP exports go to device/share rather than appearing as unreadable Studio files.

Drive setup remains blocked: existing Cloud project needs Drive API and an Android
OAuth client for com.hyzen.pharmd with the original signing certificate. See
DRIVE_PIPELINE_1_4.md. No source URLs, Drive permissions, accounts or cloud settings
were changed. No live Drive speed improvement has been established. As a working
fallback, absent/disabled API configuration restores the original online preview
and public download/export endpoints. Public download confirmation is parsed only
for Google's HTTPS hosts and the same file ID. Private access is not bypassed.

Validation: Flutter regression tests plus Android instrumentation verify page
order/rotation/text retention, separate PDF annotations, password enforcement,
compression, OCR and structured document exports. Camera hardware/UI acceptance
requires a physical Android device; a scanner bridge test is not a camera test.
docs/DRIVE_PIPELINE_1_4.md:
# Native Drive delivery — 1.4.0

## Implementation

The academic reader uses PDFium/pdfrx `PdfViewer.uri`,
`preferRangeAccess: true`, `useProgressiveLoading: true`. It never embeds the
Google Drive `/preview` UI for PDFs. The old URL helpers remain for compatibility
and historical benchmarks; production preview and save no longer call them.
Existing original URLs, file IDs and offline keys are retained. Google Workspace
Docs/Sheets/Slides use the official `files.export` API; binary PDFs use
`GET https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/{id}?alt=media`.

Metadata is cached for five minutes, separately for each Google account. OAuth
bearer tokens stay in memory and are refreshed before reuse. No client secret,
service-account JSON or refresh token is embedded in the app. The Google account
connection is separate from the app's email/password login. Logging out clears
the Drive authorization held by this app.

Downloads stream to private app storage. A `.part` file and resume journal retain
an interrupted transfer. Resume appends only after a matching source/version and
valid HTTP 206 Content-Range; If-Range protects ETag-based resumes. A server that
returns 200 restarts safely. Invalid responses discard partial data. A ready PDF
requires the PDF signature, an EOF marker and the expected full byte length,
plus a successful native Android PdfRenderer parse with at least one page.
Pause/retry preserve partial bytes. Local delete removes only the app copy and
its partial journal, never anything in Drive. The maximum is 250 MB per file.
pdfrx manages the reader's recent range cache; offline copies have explicit user
ownership and are separate. Google Docs export endpoints do not support Range.

## Owner configuration still required

The existing Android `google-services.json` has no OAuth clients. Testing its
current client API key against Drive returned HTTP 403:
`Requests to this API drive method google.apps.drive.v3.DriveFiles.Get are blocked.`
Do not repurpose this restricted Firebase key or make source files public.

1. In the existing Google Cloud project, enable Google Drive API.
2. Configure Google OAuth consent and a native Android OAuth client for
   `com.hyzen.pharmd` with the existing release signing SHA-1. Download the updated
   `google-services.json`. Do not rotate the release signing key.
3. For public academic files, optionally provide a properly restricted public
   Drive API key with `--dart-define=HYZEN_DRIVE_API_KEY=...`. A client API key is
   not a secret and cannot grant access to private files. Configure package and
   certificate restrictions appropriate for the deployed transport.
4. For private files, the learner uses Connect Google Drive and grants read-only
   access. Their Google account must already have access to the source document.
   Full Drive read-only scopes may require Google verification before public use.
5. Web account authorization needs the public web OAuth client ID via
   `HYZEN_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID` and the preview domain as an authorized origin.

No accounts, source academic URLs, cloud permissions or API configuration were
changed automatically in this revision. Without the configuration above, Drive
will display a clear connection/setup error; an APK cannot bypass Google's API
authorization requirements.

## Honest performance acceptance

Run `python3 qa/drive_benchmark.py --output qa/drive_benchmark_results.json`.
It tests the SAME three existing academic IDs for old `/preview`, old download,
API head range and complete API transfer. Output records response code, TTFB,
elapsed time and received bytes. Errors are recorded as errors, not speed wins.
This network script does not measure a rendered first page. For that, measure
on the SAME phone/network in both builds, cold cache, three repetitions per PDF;
record median time to first painted page, transfer bytes before page one, and
full offline-save duration. Do not claim a successful before/after result while
the Drive API returns 403 or no authorized account is available.

## Optional mirror architecture (design only; no files migrated)

Keep Drive as source of truth. An owner-approved worker tracks Drive changes,
copies eligible PDFs to private object storage and records `fileId`, Drive
version, checksum, size and mirror object version in a delivery manifest.
An authenticated gateway verifies Firebase ID tokens and entitlement, looks up
the existing file ID, and returns a short-lived signed CDN URL. CDN must support
Range/206, ETag/If-Range, Content-Length and correct Content-Type; expose these
headers for browser CORS. Private documents must not become public cache objects.
Use workload identity/ADC on the server, never service-account keys in clients.
On a version mismatch, serve Drive or regenerate the mirror; never serve an
old student's private file to another account. Roll out behind a disabled
feature flag after owner approval, access audit, cost estimate and checksum
validation. Preserve current academic URLs; resolve fileId to delivery at runtime.

## PDF Studio boundary

The original 1.4.0 revision used rasterized page operations. Version 1.4.1
supersedes this boundary: see PDF_STUDIO_1_4_1.md for lossless page operations,
standard annotation exports, scanner, OCR, AES and structured document creation.
